question: Do eight transparent deterministic 2D physicochemical descriptors add information to existing representations under the same fixed readout on original train scaffold OOF?
source_limit: Original paper supports membrane-related descriptors/pharmacophores, not this exact eight-feature set or its efficacy. Eight-feature ablation is our hypothesis; no true pKa/pH/logD/transport label inferred.
competing_explanations: descriptors add missing accessible physicochemical information
existing learned/fingerprint representations already carry that information
gain reflects scaling/regularization interaction or added capacity rather than new chemistry
dataset support/assay mixture dominates all representations
source_gate: Accepted asset family does not imply Pgp cache exists. Original Sol first supplies exact original train identity, per-representation raw all-row cache identities or explicit absent, exact prior internal split if any. No fresh encoding in source request.

partition.preference: Reuse an accepted Pgp original-train scaffold 5-fold all-row OOF if it exists, with immutable membership. Otherwise scientific owner will bind an explicit 5-fold scaffold construction using accepted project partition factory after raw row mapping is available. No new split has been made.
partition.grouping: Original canonical duplicates remain original rows but share partition/bootstrap group. Scaffold unit distinct from canonical molecule; exact current factory identity required.
partition.no_inner_stop_required: fixed logistic readout no model selection/early stopping; all other four outer folds fit, heldout fifth never used for fitting/scaling.

descriptors.input: Original accepted canonical-isomeric SMILES parsing without new salt/tautomer/stereo cleanup; no external pKa model
descriptors.invalid: no row drop/imputation; explicit unsupported row blocks whole-row comparison until separate science decision

preprocessing.CheM_Mini: per-feature fit-only float64 mean/std ddof0, std<1e-8 ->1; cast features float64 for logistic
preprocessing.Morgan: binary original bits identity; do not per-bit standardize
preprocessing.descriptors: fit-only float64 mean/std ddof0 std<1e-8 ->1, append in fixed order
preprocessing.label: unchanged original binary train.Y

readout.seed: no claimed seed replicate; deterministic solver/fold is unit
readout.software: actual installed supported version to be source-bound before new TASK; no unpinned floating package
readout.nonconvergence: record invalid comparison; no silent C/tolerance tuning

analysis.lock: all 6x5=30 new prediction records complete and immutable before first comparative metric; no fit authorized yet
analysis.primary: three paired within-representation descriptor-minus-base equal-fold AUROC deltas; all original train OOF rows
secondary: Brier/logloss and fixed p>=0.5 confusion/error transitions
analysis.whole_groups: all rows; baseline-consensus correct/error among three base representations; baseline disagreement bottom20/middle60/top20; fit-bank Morgan low-support; every descriptor-vs-base repair/harm/persistent-error/neither-error, all complements/members/denominators. Definitions/membership freeze from base OOF before candidate outcome inspection; these are exploratory outcome-defined baseline groups, not independent confirmatory cohorts.
analysis.low_support: perfold nearest Morgan Tanimoto to fit bank; fit reference excludes same canonical molecule group; q20 of fit leave-group-out similarity, fixed linear quantile. Actual canonical source binding needed before computation.
analysis.uncertainty: paired scaffold cluster bootstrap 2000 resamples seed20261103, conditional fixed OOF predictions; 95% descriptive and98.333333% intervals for three-family simultaneous claim; resample groups within folds, recompute equal-fold AUROC; undefined single-class replicates reported, not filled0
analysis.mechanistic_limit: descriptor effect also changes accessible feature/scaling/regularization. Does not prove causal membrane mechanism. No gain significance is not equivalence.

prospective_budget.time_allowance: not authorized; bound after actual source/cache availability and executor estimate

decision_rules.support: repeatable paired descriptor gain with complete relevant group repair and no material harm; interpret per representation first
decision_rules.negative: no stable increment closes tested exact8+fixedlinear recipe only, not all physicochemical information or all heads
decision_rules.reopen: independent new train evidence with specific unaddressed mechanism, source-mapped assay fields or independently admitted distinct feature; no arbitrary seed/descriptor sweep
